<Ui xmlns="http://www.blizzard.com/wow/ui/">
  <!-- Secure buttons a SecureGroupHeader or SecureGroupPetHeader births, in combat
       too. registerForClicks is applied when the button is created, so a child
       born in lockdown answers right-click (togglemenu) and click-cast bindings at
       once; RegisterForClicks itself is protected and a restricted handle cannot
       call it (RestrictedFrames.lua HANDLE). -->
  <Button name="MSUF_GroupHeaderUnitButtonTemplate" inherits="SecureUnitButtonTemplate, PingableUnitFrameTemplate" registerForClicks="AnyUp" virtual="true"/>
  <Button name="MSUF_GroupAdditionalUnitTemplate" inherits="SecureUnitButtonTemplate" registerForClicks="AnyUp" virtual="true">
    <Size x="100" y="24"/>
    <Frames>
      <StatusBar parentKey="Health">
        <Anchors><Anchor point="TOPLEFT"/><Anchor point="BOTTOMRIGHT"/></Anchors>
        <BarTexture file="Interface\TargetingFrame\UI-StatusBar"/>
        <Layers>
          <Layer level="BACKGROUND"><Texture parentKey="Background" setAllPoints="true"><Color r="0.04" g="0.04" b="0.04" a="0.95"/></Texture></Layer>
          <Layer level="OVERLAY"><FontString parentKey="Name" inherits="GameFontHighlightSmall"><Anchors><Anchor point="LEFT" x="3"/><Anchor point="RIGHT" x="-3"/></Anchors></FontString></Layer>
        </Layers>
      </StatusBar>
    </Frames>
    <Scripts><OnLoad function="MSUF_GroupAdditionalUnitOnLoad"/></Scripts>

</Ui>

# Globals the offline client-boot harness does not model, read at load by the

# a new one fails the smoke, and a row nothing reads any more fails it too.

# table and secret are Blizzard surfaces the harness answers with a permissive
